timing_verdict.label: GOOD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: GOOD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,300s won per dollar (lower end)

WHY: Multiple sources indicate the won is currently near or at a recent low point (1,300s range), supported by a large expected corporate tax payment of 46 trillion won in August that will boost won supply and demand. The Bank of Korea's hawkish hold on rates and strong semiconductor performance suggest the won may strengthen from here, making now relatively attractive for dollar purchases.

TIP: Lock in your monthly $2,000 conversion now while the won is in this favorable 1,300s range, as the trend appears positioned to strengthen the won (making dollars more expensive) in coming months.
